messages:
alex: Heads up  the smoothie blender in Kitchen A died a heroic death this morning (loud bang, then silence). If anyone has a small personal blender we can borrow for todayI have breakfast meetings. Also who left a half-tub of hummus with no label? Smells fine but mystery hummus is peak suspense. :thinking_face:
meera: Oof the blender? I'll drop off my mini Ninja at 9:30. It'll do single-serve smoothies. Re: hummus  not mine. Can we institute a quick label format? Something like: `name | date | discard after` so it's clear.
tony: I can bring an emergency jar of almond milk (sealed) for anyone who needs a pour-over. Also, let's please stop using sharp knives on the counter without the cutting board. Saw a nick in the butcher block. :grimacing:
claire: Agree on the cutting board rule. I'll stick a paper sign: "Cut on board only" and tape a cheap $3 plastic board to the inside of the cabinet for communal use.
pat: Mystery hummus owner: it was mine  forgot to write my name, sorry! I'll put a Post-it on it now. Also tiny poll: Friday snack run  pick one: mini croissants or savory sliders? :croissant: :hamburger:
alex: Mini ninja + hummus claim noted. Poll please, I'm team croissants all the way.
meera: Sliders for me  I have a nut allergy guest on Friday and sliders are easier to label.
kitchen-bot: Poll created: "Friday snack run" options: Mini croissants, Savory sliders. Ends 1995550300. Reminder: "Return borrowed mini Ninja" 1995557200.
tonY: (typo correction) tony: Also adding: coin jar update  we have $12.25 in snacks fund. If people want to chip in $5 for a new full-size blender, say aye.
claire: Aye from me. Blenders > hourly smoothie sadness. I'll Venmo whoever buys it.
pat: I can chip $3 now, will add to the jar. Can we add a small ledger next to the jar? Simple note: who paid, what for.
meera: I'll print a tiny ledger pad at 2pm and tape to the wall. Also can someone grab a roll of cling wrap? We're out and soup lids are suffering.
alex: Thanks everyone. If you borrow the mini Ninja please return it before 5pm. No one likes blender FOMO. :blender: 
claire: I'll lead a 10-minute "kitchen orientation" at 4:45 for the new folks  show where the labels, board, and jar are. Free croissant for attendees.
kitchen-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Kitchen orientation + croissant handout" 1995555100.
